steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Quick, upstairs!

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: I heard from a student just now. The Sankta we're looking for is hiding there!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: A pipe organ.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The entire spire is designed in the shape of an enormous pipe organ. It matches the distinguishing characteristics of the background sounds in the cello piece we heard earlier.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: There's a very high chance that the wanted criminal Arturia is hiding here.

steps.name: Strange Voice From a Sculpture
steps.text: Will you keep going up?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Originium Arts that use sculptures to synchronize voices. The very same kind I heard at the site of the attack at Karl Schmidt Street.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: So you started working with the 'Witch King's remains' after all, Arturia.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: If I told you... I never cared who they were, and had no interest in Leithanien's political turmoil, would you believe me?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The resentment of individuals has never been a motive for your crimes, and I see power struggles and profit as even less likely candidates.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Oh, Federico. You really do know me better than anyone. Everyone else's minds are tainted with thoughts, while you... boring as you are, you and I are alike.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: All these years, I've walked amidst chaos simply to find an even stronger soul.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: This journey was no different. I simply accepted the invitation of a few Leithanian acquaintances. That's the only reason for my visit.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Even without my assurances, you should already know in your heart that, no matter what becomes of Leithanien tomorrow, it will have no immediate effect on Laterano.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Perhaps.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Then, can I ask of you the same thing the Lupo boy did? That you ignore what you see here?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You're upstairs.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Hm. You guessed right. I suppose I could give you a reward and let you see me.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: How about this? Once my wish comes true, I will be waiting for you at the city gates on the day I leave Zwillingstürme.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: When the time comes, if you still want me to go back to Laterano with you, I promise you I'll think about it.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: An arrest is not a request. You do not have the right to 'think about it.'

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: My lovely baby brother, you really... don't know when to give up.

steps.name: Gendarmerie A
steps.text: Target spotted!

steps.name: Gendarmerie B
steps.text: It's the Sankta who was at the scene of Captain Bordin's murder! Everyone, surround Sonata Spire immediately!

steps.name: Gendarmerie A
steps.text: The suspect didn't stop! He ran upstairs!

steps.name: Gendarmerie B
steps.text: After him!
One floor after another. Leithanien's spires are always so, so tall.
There are more and more pursuers by the second. Shoes of various ages step on the stairs, each producing a different sound.

The pipes that form the spire's walls are vibrating even more powerfully now. The sound of the organ and the footsteps blend together to form a unique piece, with the squads meandering up the spiral staircase as the performers.
At the front, Federico maintains a steady pace through the entire process. Even his heartrate remains unchanged.
His eyes do not see any of the pursuing soldiers. All he can see is the target before him. A decade has passed, but as though only a day has gone by, nothing has changed.
The last floor.
By leaping past the few dozen steps before him, he will reach his target.

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: D-Don't move!

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: You Sankta... Don't tell me you can actually fly! Just how fast can you run?!

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: Good thing the students told me about another shortcut up here... I'm beat!

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: I don't care how amazing you are. If you take another step, I'm taking you down!

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: So what will you do? Will you declare war on the Leithanian Gendarmerie?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: They, too, are enforcers of law, much like your countless coworkers at the Notarial Hall. However, unlike you, they hesitate before plunging themselves into battle. They feel fear.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: When you charge ahead in pursuit of your target with no regard for anything else, do you lay eyes on these ordinary men and women for even a moment?

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: What's that sound? Is somebody talking to you?

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: Are they your buddy? You have friends here, don't you? Did you lure us into an ambush?!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: She is not my friend.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: But I am a fellow Sankta.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: We both have the same halos above our heads and the same wings on our backs. We're even related by blood.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: How will you persuade them that you came all this way not to aid me, but to arrest me?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The misunderstandings of others have never been a reason to waver.

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: My teammates will be here soon. You won't get away!

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Surrender.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Approach those who misunderstand you and end this pointless pursuit. Clearly explain your position and motives to them.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: And then, accept the fact that you have failed once again.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You're right in front of me. I have unearthed evidence of your Arts.

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: Drop all your weapons! Back away from the talking sculpture!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I ask that you please calm down.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I am not your enemy.

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: That's what all smooth-talking criminals say! I trust nothing but my eyes and my Arts Unit!

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: You'll pay for what you did to Captain Bordin, Sankta!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I was not responsible for Loris Bordin's death.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: They're already under the thumb of their most irrational emotions.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Your music is affecting everyone in the area.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Is this really my doing...? Perhaps this is what they've always wanted, deep down?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I told you long ago. Much like our society, most people's minds are filled with chaos.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You ignore this fact. The only thing on your mind is to sidestep the chaos and find the most efficient shortcut to resolving the issue at hand.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Poor Federico. Have you still not noticed why you've never managed to catch me, even though you've pursued me all these years?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: How is a man who's sealed off his own perceptions—unwilling to touch the chaos—supposed to reach chaos itself?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: That doesn't concern me.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: And you are not chaos itself.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You are a criminal, and your actions beget chaos. Which is why you must be stopped.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Like right now—

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I have you now, Arturia.
Federico raises his gun.
The bullet pierces the speaking sculpture opposite him and continues in a straight path until it shatters the wall.
The black-haired Sankta is standing on a balcony not far away. With her back facing the setting sun and a bow in her hand, she smiles faintly.
Meanwhile, beam after beam of Arts light finally reach the executor.

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: What's going on? I just saw a bunch of Gendarmerie surrounding Sonata Spire!

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: Haven't you heard? It's the Witch King's remains! They're hiding among us in the school, researching Arts used to hurt people! It's so scary! How come none of us ever noticed?!

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: I... I don't believe it. How can you be sure they aren't lying? Their Majesties have long seen the school as a thorn in their side. It's probably an excuse to destroy Ludwigs-Universität—

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: How dare you doubt Their Majesties?! Oh, I get it. You're under the Witch King's remains' influence yourself, aren't you? No, you might even be the one who led them here in the first place. You're one of them!

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: How could you slander me like that? We've shared a room ever since we started school! I even took you to my family's villa by the lake every summer!

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: Hah! And how many of your family's fine possessions in that villa were rewards from the Witch King?

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: Like that set of Arts crystals in the basement, used to observe Catastrophes! They were refined from the ashes of the Infected, weren't they?

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: What did you just—Defame me all you like, but don't you dare drag my grandmother into this! She was the greatest Catastrophe scholar in Einwald, and she died for Leithanien on the northern Sturmland battlefield!

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: My eyes... I'm reporting you and your family to the Gendarmerie and the Empresses' Voice!

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: You wretched... Witch King's remnant...

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: What does that make you? An idiot who crawled your way here by clutching the hems of the Twin Empresses' dresses? If your family didn't so happen to have been on the right side, the lot of you would still be boatmen ferrying the nobles!

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: What do you even know? Did you ever learn to truly respect knowledge? You don't even know which instruments to use for different occasions.

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: Of course, I always knew you looked down on me! Come on! Fight me!

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: What are you doing protecting him, Maeyer? Your family used to serve to the nobles too. Aren't you itching to take this chance to beat up these haughty snobs?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: The university forbids Originium Arts duels between students.

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: When a pack of wild beasts gains knowledge, that doesn't mean they've become civilized. All they've learned is how to use it to hide their fangs.

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: We should be ridding ourselves of this brutish rabble. They'll only tarnish the elegance and values of Ludwigs-Universität!

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: We worked for centuries to earn the right for commoners and nobles to sit in one classroom together. Neither Ludwigs-Universität or society as a whole should regress.

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: Out of the way, Maeyer, or you're my enemy too.

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: Hah, you aren't much better than him, Maeyer! The old fart who raised you has been stinking up this place longer than anyone else, hasn't he?

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: I heard he's lived for hundreds of years, and he keeps extending his life with the bones of the dead! Maybe he put you together from bones too?

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: I've also heard rumors. They say even the Twins were molded by Fremont with his witchcraft.

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: Nonsense! Fremont and the Witch King were the best of friends! I bet he's the leader of the Witch King's remains!

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: —Both of you should get some rest.
His longsword, wrapped in cloth, blocks the Arts flying toward him from both sides.
Lessing single-handedly stops both of them.
He then lifts his head find even more beams of Arts being flung toward one another.
Firelight, ice crystals, strange energy balls, frenzied flowerbeds, and upside-down fountains. Every spell ever taught in lectures is now interwoven with one another, all at once.
There is a thunderous rumble. A golem running around has knocked over a road sign.
'Ludwigs-Universität.' The shining school crest falls into a cloud of dust.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... I'm really getting on in years. It's only been such a short distance, yet it feels as though I've climbed hundreds of steps.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I think I heard the sounds of a fight aboveground.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Are the Witch King's remains fighting with those from the university?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You're too weak. Leave the war to the others for now.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: But suppose this war started because of me. I'd have no reason to hide.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You feel guilty. That's only natural.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Fate chose you over the others to live, and that is not necessarily a mercy. I know better than anyone how that feels.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Have you experienced a similar suffering?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I was gravely injured during the final battle, and spent the better part of a year in a confused state. It was Professor Fremont who spent the time and effort to cure me.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: That day, when I finally woke up from my nightmare of being bound to those blood-red steps, the first thought that entered my mind was that... my classmates, friends, and even my lover were all gone.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: In my despair, I climbed to the top of Sonata Spire, wishing to leap from it.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: He found me up there, and I asked him: Was everything I did for Leithanien truly meaningful?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What happened next? Did you find the meaning you sought?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: He gave me a number of books on the Güldenesgesatz. He told me that whenever I can't answer my own questions, history can.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: So I started studying the Güldenesgesatz, how Leithanien came to be, and the direction it should go. I researched these topics for twenty years.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: And... what answer did you come to?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: The problems facing Leithanien have always existed, ever since the birth of the Güldenesgesatz. The cultural differences between tribes, the rift between nobles and commoners, etc. All these have existed for over a thousand years.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: History has proven how difficult it is to change Leithanien, to give its citizens new lives, and to end the endless sacrifices.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You must possess both absolute power and unbreakable resolve.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Luckily, such power wasn't completely lost, and we're on our way to find it right now.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: So this power you speak of is hidden somewhere on this old campus?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Ja.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: And by obtaining it, we'll be able to resolve the predicament before us, eliminate the threat of the Witch King's remains, and... change my fate, all at the same time?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: It was only my confidence in it that gave me the courage to go against my teacher.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Come, Franz. It's right up ahead.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Nein.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You again?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Don't follow him any further. You shouldn't go there.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Come back with me.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: ...So you can strap me to a table again and make me a vessel for summoning the Witch King's legacy? In your dreams.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Let the dregs of the past be buried by time, and vanish from Leithanien entirely.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: They will. I'm doing what I can to ensure that happens.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: But before that—

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: There's no 'before' anything. I've thrown away even a guarantee from the Kaiserinnen. Do you really think I'd listen to the promises of a remnant of the Witch King?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: All I want is to obtain the Witch King's legacy. The people you're talking about—the ones who want to summon the Witch King—are my enemies too.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: ...Not this again. Is always denying your involvement really that fun for you people? Or are you fighting over who gets credit for what, all to crawl ever closer to that rotten throne?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm sick of all this. Can't you pick some other trophy... and stay away from me?!

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Hm—The stairs beneath us are... vanishing?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: This school is much older than you can imagine. Don't resist the power of history. Give up.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: No—!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Lessing, not even you can fight a transforming staircase on your own. You'll only hurt yourself.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Ugh—Ah!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Are you this cruel to yourself, too?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Look, I don't know what Gerhard told you, but don't listen to him.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Rather than someone who claims to be grateful to the Witch King and wants to lock me away in a lab... I'd rather trust someone who once stood against the Witch King and saved my life.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: The advent of the Genesis Horn is extremely unlikely to hurt you in any way. The old man and I triple-checked that.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: The process may be painful, but not unbearable.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: But you aren't me. What right do you have to make that decision for me?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: I don't, but everyone has a responsibility that only they can bear.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Stop running away. If neither the Voice of Mundane nor the Urtica bloodline are things that you can change, then all you can do is accept them.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Accept them?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: The ones who killed my parents and forced the Voice of Mundane into me gave me that same excuse.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: The ones who almost turned me into a bomb to blow up a city—the ones who killed my brother—said nearly the same thing!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Why do you people always have these self-righteous justifications? Is that really enough for you to ignore all the screams you're creating?!

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Verdammt... Still not letting go, even after that blow? Are you really so eager to be torn to pieces by the ancient Arts on these stairs?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: I'd rather die than see you fall into their hands.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: This has always been about more than just you... More than me, as well.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: When Leithanien's future is at stake, any sacrifice is...

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Franz, come.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: We need to keep going.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: This energy enveloping me... Did you save me?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I didn't do it to save you. I just can't stand people like you, obsessed with sacrificing themselves.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Franz...

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: ...Ebenholz.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Don't walk right into a trap.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Come on, Franz.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What is this place...?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: This is where the key I mentioned lies. The key capable of fundamentally changing Leithanien.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: A thousand years ago, sages from the various tribes came together and signed an alliance, witnessed by an all-powerful, immortal caster.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: This pact laid out the relationship between the tribes, established the Kurfürsten system, and set the foundation for Leithanian morality and appreciation of the arts.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You mean... the Güldenesgesatz.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Ja.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: In the centuries that followed, the Güldenesgesatz ensured Leithanien's stability.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: That is, until a century ago, when the Siracusans became the first to turn their backs on the Güldenesgesatz and seek independence from Leithanien.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: It was... a bloody conflict, lasting several years. With one part of the choir gone, the Movement became destabilized, and many regions fell into chaos. Leithanien was on the brink of collapse.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: In those dire circumstances, a man stepped forward.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: He realized that the Güldenesgesatz had to be amended. Only by removing Siracusa from the score entirely could the reborn movement unite the nine remaining regions.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: ...The Witch King.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Correct, my child.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: What you see before you is the most mysterious chamber of Ludwigs-Universität, where House Urtica's Arts—circulated for centuries—are gathered. And where Herkunftshorn rewrote the Güldenesgesatz.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I cannot agree to your methods.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Even if I were willing to believe you that the Genesis Horn truly exists, it is incapable of descending upon Zwillingstürme as it is now.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Hmph, this is exactly why I didn't bother notifying you people. The Gesatzswächter have heads even harder than their helmets.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Your so-called safe and controllable plan to summon the Genesis Horn has already failed.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: The Witch King's remnants are hiding within the campus, and with all the relics of the Witch King stored here, they will bring forth a disaster of unprecedented scale.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: And for now, there is only one efficient means of stopping them.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: I refuse.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: We'll evacuate all the students and university staff.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Ludwigs-Universität contains much more of value than just its students and instructors!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: I've had tenure here for centuries! Can you even imagine how many precious Arts devices and enchantments there are here?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I understand, but I ask that you please prioritize Leithanien's safet—

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Absolutely not. You say you understand, but that's far beyond your meager capabilities.
The old man's voice calms down.
His habitual tongue-lashing comes to a halt. As he stares at the man in front of him, the shadow of his skinny body on the wall suddenly grows very tall, like a spire covered in vines.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: These spires are not for you to meddle with.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: If you dare suggest destroying them again, I'll throw all of you out at once.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...Something isn't right.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: The sunset outside the window... disappeared?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: The sun's not the only thing that's gone.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Ugh....

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: How very brave of you.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: However, don't even try to touch my shadow again, unless you wish to be dissolved by it.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Herr Fremont's shadow...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: It's fractured into... innumerable silk strings...

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Droste. Lower your Arts.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Do not probe those shadows. His true form is hidden inside. You're not yet strong enough to stare directly into his soul.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Oh? So you've figured out who I am?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Then you must also know that no one who's been thrown outside by me has ever managed to climb back alive.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: If you're brave enough, feel free to see for yourself.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: There is nothing out there whatsoever. I assure you that were you to leap outside, you wouldn't even have time to scream. Your mouths, vocal cords, and limbs would all perish in the darkness.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I've never even heard of Arts like these.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: ...'Exile.'

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I've heard it spoken of in legends, but was never sure how much truth there was to it. Until today.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: You've been hiding in Leithanien for so long now. Why choose now to reveal your identity?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Herr Lich?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: A Lich?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You mean... Herr Fremont is a Sarkaz?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Hoh, a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Aside from the immortal bastards of the Royal Court, very few these days have been able to deduce my identity.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: You say I've been 'hiding'... That's a good way to put it, little lamb. When you put it like that, I've stayed in this country for far too long, haven't I?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: I never meant to hide my true identity. It's only that I've grown used to being cooped up this spire, with my head buried in the literature here.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: It's you people who forgot who I was.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: And all of you keep bothering me with Leithanien's messes. Sometimes it's the wolves bickering with the lambs. Other times, it's two deer locking antlers. Haven't you wasted enough of my time?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Now scram, and tell Grimmacht that I don't care anymore. Once I've recovered what I loaned from the Genesis Horn, the Liches will be gone from Leithanien for good.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: And if it's not too much to ask, get the hell out of here and never set foot in my holy temple again!

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: The Genesis Horn cannot be allowed to descend.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Did you not understand a word of what I just said?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I am no match for you.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: But that doesn't mean Leithanien's Gesatzswächter will give up so easily.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: And what about you, my lovely doe? Do you also seek death?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Let her leave.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Herr Fremont. Surely there is still room to negotiate?

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: You can stop trying.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Hm? It's you.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: Hello, Droste... Nein. I should call you Frau Hochberg.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: Allow me to reintroduce myself.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: My name is Michael, the personal envoy of Her Majesty Grimmacht.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: So you're another Empresses' Voice?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I am not.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: An Empresses' Voice serves both Kaiserinnen at once.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: While I belong only to Grimmacht.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...Can I take that to mean that we're enemies?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: The last time we met, I already told you that we might walk different paths.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: What are you dawdling around for, wolf cub? Hurry up and throw them out of here!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: ...Right away.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Herr Reiner, Frau Hochberg. These are Grimmacht's orders.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I am to assist Herr Fremont and ensure that the Genesis Horn makes its advent on Zwillingstürme.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: But why?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: First, because this was Grimmacht's promise to Herr Fremont.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: As a show of gratitude to the Liches' contribution to Leithanien over the past millennium, and to foster a continued, long-lasting friendship, we will help Herr Fremont retrieve what once belonged to him.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Second, if there's anyone who has the right to use the Genesis Horn, it can only be my liege.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Your liege.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Singular.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: ...Don't let him get to you, Droste.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: It doesn't matter if it was Grimmacht or Ewigegnade who wished for this. There's no reason for you to get involved.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: House Hochberg has already sacrificed too much for the conflict between the Witch King and the Twin Empresses, and for the Güldenesgesatz.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I will see you out of here safely... even if I must put my life on the line.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Why is the spire... shaking?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: It's not the spire that's shaking. It's the ground beneath us.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: The shadow is fracturing. Something is trying to make its way through.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Is there something underneath the campus's plate?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: House Urtica's secret chamber... Those stupid sheep barged into my underground space!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Fremont, you fool! You've been in Leithanien for far too long. You've contracted the stupidity of these bighorn sheep!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Thank goodness... The legends were true. The old man was telling the truth.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: All these enchantments and Arts devices... Every last one perfectly preserved.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: This is living history! Not even the greatest history books were able to go into such fine detail about the situation!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Wait, this is...
A silhouette emerges from the darkness.
Followed by another, and another.
Their robes, hoods, and masks have not changed at all in the past twenty years.
A silhouette he could not be more familiar with emerges from the nightmare that's plagued him for his entire life, and steps right in front of him.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Welcome back to your territory—

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: —Graf Urtica.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Professor Hoffmann!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: What is it, Franz?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Look what I just found... This is an Arts scroll that's been missing for ages!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: And this! It can't possibly be the brass instrument used by Herkunftshorn himself, can it? There are treasures here far more valuable than I ever imagined!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: My... My head... It hurts, verdammt!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Why now, of all times? When it's the most dangerous...? No, I can't fall here.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Professor... Hoffmann... Please go...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I... I'll... protect you...

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Franz? What in blazes are you talking about?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Lessing was right. I can't keep running away.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: All this time, there's always been someone protecting me.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: All the people by my side... first it was that lady, then the respectable Gendarmerie, then Herr Czerny, and... him. All of them, more willing to sacrifice themselves than I.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: But this time, I'll do it.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'll kill myself here. I still have the Voice of Mundane they love so much... That should be more than enough to blow this chamber of evil to smithereens.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Grab what you want... while you still can... Go... Hurry...

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: It's time you got some rest, you silly child.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What... did you say?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: My life's work is about to be realized, but how am I supposed to accomplish all this without you?
This is the second time.
Someone holds a brass instrument up high and violently strikes his head.
'Graf Urtica.'
Many years ago, he woke up to find himself shackled to that chair. In the ten years since, he was granted this name.
He never wanted the title of Graf, and he despised the name Urtica more than anything. Even the name Franz, an old-fashioned name used by countless noble children, is something he has always loathed.

In that spire standing tall in the center of the Urtica Grafschaft, he tried to escape that chair again and again. After all, it was never him that the nobles reporting on the affairs of the Grafschaft truly cared about.
They knew each other well, which is why the guards only ever came early in the day, to drag him from the curtains to the chair.
After a long time, he would finally be allowed to roam the spire aimlessly. Not even the guards noticed him then, until the next morning arrived.
The days went by in that vicious cycle.
If he hadn't tried to run even farther afield, hadn't thought about the other person suffering a similar fate, hadn't tried to resist, and hadn't been shown any hope whatsoever...
Then perhaps he would have been bound to that chair his entire life.
But then, today, he finds himself caught once again. And behind him is yet another familiar chair.
Its shadow is simple, elegant, and entwined with thorns. At a single glance, it feels as if his eyes, brain, and heart have been pierced with intense pain.
Even the cheers around him are similar.
It's just that, this time, they call him—
'Witch King.'
